jobs.title: Transportation Engineering Director
jobs.description:

As a civil engineering transportation director, you`ll be oversee the planning, design, and maintenance of a public or private organization's transportation infrastructure programs, such as roads, bridges, and transit systems. You`ll manage staff and budgets, develop capital improvement plans, ensure projects meet standards, collaborate with stakeholders, and handle business development and client relations.

What You'll Do:

Direct a team of engineers and technical staff, conducting performance evaluations, and managing budgets and departmental operations.
Develop and implement long-term plans for transportation systems, including capital improvement plans.
Oversee the design and delivery of complex transportation projects to ensure they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
Provide technical guidance and act as the expert on transportation engineering principles, traffic control, and public roadway regulations.
Collaborate with external partners such as government agencies, metropolitan planning organizations, and community groups.
Lead efforts to secure new projects, develop proposals, and negotiate contracts, especially in the private sector.

What You'll Need:

Bachelor of Science in Civil or Structural Engineering.
Minimum Fifteen years of transportation engineering experience.
Professional Engineer (PE) license.
Proficiency in AutoCAD and Civil3D software.
This hybrid job operates between an office environment and a field environment and routinely requires the use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones and copy machines. May require occasional exposure to work environments that may include inclement weather, heat, humidity, noise, hazard, atmospheric conditions, and bodies of water, depending on project requirements.
While performing the duties of this job, physical demands of the employee include frequent sitting, moving, standing, talking, hearing, and occasional balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, handling, grasping, and feeling. This job may occasionally require operating a company vehicle, and lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling up to 35 lbs.

Anduril's Maritime Division is responsible for planning and executing Anduril's product and revenue roadmap for maritime missions. Experience in a senior role leading maritime programs from initial concept through test and delivery to customers

Position Summary:

The Head of Engineering is responsible for leading all engineering, product management, quality, compliance, and new product introduction activities across multiple business units and international locations.

This role provides strategic and technical leadership, ensuring engineering excellence while driving innovation, operational efficiency, and exceptional customer satisfaction. Working closely with Sales, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and executive leadership, the successful candidate will build a high-performing engineering organisation capable of supporting long-term business growth and delivering world-class interconnect solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership

Lead engineering activities across multiple global business units.
Build, develop and mentor a high-performing engineering team with clear ownership and accountability.
Foster a culture focused on technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Align closely with global manufacturing engineering teams to ensure efficient product development and successful production launch.

Product Management

Develop and execute the product roadmap in line with business strategy and manufacturing capability.
Manage the existing product portfolio, ensuring complete technical documentation and ongoing product support.
Oversee Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) and Product Change Notices (PCNs) to minimise customer disruption.
Lead product testing and validation programmes to strengthen product performance and market competitiveness.

Design Engineering

Establish an efficient and responsive design engineering function.
Deliver custom and modified product designs to meet customer-specific requirements.
Improve speed to design and speed to quotation.
Drive innovation through concept development, simulation, reverse engineering and design for manufacture.

Engineering Documentation

Review and approve customer drawings and engineering documentation before production release.
Approve design revisions and first article inspections.
Assess customer requirements against manufacturing capabilities, tooling constraints and commercial considerations.

Quality & Compliance

Own engineering quality standards and product compliance across internally manufactured and externally sourced products.
Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards and regulatory requirements including ISO, IATF 16949, REACH and RoHS.
Ensure timely investigation and resolution of quality issues through effective corrective action processes.

Continuous Improvement

Drive improvements across engineering, quality and compliance processes.
Improve engineering productivity, resource utilisation and project visibility through best practice methodologies.

New Product Introduction (NPI)

Establish a disciplined NPI process that consistently delivers successful product launches aligned with customer and business objectives.

Customer Engagement

Support strategic customer relationships by providing technical leadership throughout the design and product development process.
Partner with commercial teams to secure new business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Ensure close integration between Engineering, Sales, Operations, Manufacturing and Supply Chain to improve execution speed and business performance.

Team Development

Recruit, develop and retain high-performing engineering professionals across multiple locations.
Create succession plans and support ongoing professional development.

Strategic Leadership

Contribute as a member of the senior leadership team to the development and execution of business strategy.
Ensure engineering capability supports long-term growth, innovation and market expansion.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. An advanced engineering qualification is desirable.

Experience

Minimum of 8 years' engineering experience within electronic components industry.
Proven experience leading engineering teams within a manufacturing environment.
Strong customer-facing engineering experience.
Extensive knowledge of connector design, product development and manufacturing processes.
Experience with APQP, PPAP and IATF 16949 methodologies.
Strong understanding of injection moulding, metal stamping and related manufacturing processes.
Demonstrated success managing cross-functional engineering projects and global teams.

Technical Skills

Advanced proficiency in SolidWorks and other CAD platforms.
Strong engineering drawing interpretation and creation skills.
Excellent knowledge of engineering specifications, testing and validation.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

Personal Attributes

Strategic thinker with strong commercial awareness.
Excellent leadership and people development skills.
Outstanding communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Highly organised with exceptional planning and project management capability.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Customer-focused with a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

Expert understanding of software engineering processes such as software estimation, DevOps, testing, etc.
Excitement about working in a fast-paced, innovation-focused startup environment.

Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. Our cars may be self-driving, but Waymo’s dynamic working environment is steered by experts like you. As our Head of Workplace Strategy and Services you will be responsible for the delivery of large-scale operations and portfolio-wide programs ensuring and facilitating the successful delivery of a consistent service program in an extremely fast paced environment with a high degree of ambiguity. You will ensure seamless delivery of workplace strategy, headcount planning, user experience, lab management, and company-wide events.

This role reports to our Director of Global Workplace & eMobility

You Will

Occupancy Planning: Architect and execute a multi-year global workplace strategy that serves as a physical manifestation of Waymo’s safety-first and innovation-led mission, directly supporting engineering teams (hardware & software). Establish global Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and KPIs that utilize workplace analytics to predict trends, optimize specialized space utilization (labs, depots, and offices), and justify infrastructure investments to executive leadership.
Organizational Scaling: Lead, scale, and inspire a global multidisciplinary organization. Foster a high-performance culture by mentoring senior leads and building a talent pipeline capable of navigating the complexities of growing offices, proving grounds, and lab infrastructure.
Change Management & Cultural Stewardship: Act as a primary steward of Waymo’s culture, leveraging the workplace as a strategic tool to drive employee retention, talent acquisition, Employee Resource programs and cross-functional agility.
Portfolio-Wide Financial Oversight: Direct a multi-million dollar OPEX/CAPEX budget with a focus on Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and rigorous ROI analysis, ensuring workplace investments yield measurable gains in engineering velocity and operational uptime.
Future-Proofing & Tech Integration: Pioneer the adoption of emerging workplace technologies and sustainable practices (ir Building Automation, Call Center Strategies), ensuring Waymo’s physical environments are as advanced and efficient as the autonomous technology we deploy.

You Have

BA/BS degree in related field such as Facilities Management, Business Management, or Engineering
10+ Years of Account Management or Outsourcing Management experience
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, ability to present in a formal setting, and ability to adapt communication to articulate program goals to a wide audience in a simple, straightforward way
Understand technological advances, change management, organizational leadership and compliance requirements, and each supports/drives workplace strategies

Certification or Industry Designation in Project, Engineering or Facilities Services
Experience in mixed use environments - office, industrial, labs or manufacturing
Demonstrable PM skills; able to advance projects with undefined scope, influence and align stakeholders

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Roblox Studio is the creation engine behind millions of immersive 3D games built by creators around the world. We are entering a major platform transition, evolving Studio into an AI-Native IDE where intelligent systems plan, act, validate, and iterate alongside creators to amplify their output. We are seeking a Technical Director, Applied AI to own the technical direction of the agentic AI systems embedded deeply into Roblox Studio. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role operating at the intersection of platform engineering, AI systems, and developer experience, where you will set the technical direction, design the architecture, and write the code.

Design and build the agentic AI systems at the core of the AI-Native IDE (planning, execution, validation, evaluation) so they are production-grade and reliable.
Decide how Studio uses coding models, agents, retrieval, tool calling, and context management across the Assistant and the broader creator workflow.
Own the quality bar and evaluation strategy, standing up quantitative and qualitative eval pipelines, including human-in-the-loop, so we ship with confidence.
Optimize these systems for latency, throughput, and cost (caching, routing, distillation, quantization).
Bring reusable patterns and best practices to teams across Studio, raising the applied-AI fluency of Studio engineering.

You Have

12+ years of engineering experience, including ownership of large-scale, long-lived platforms.
Deep, hands-on experience building LLM-powered and agentic systems in production, beyond chat-based interfaces.
Strong systems and software engineering skills, with the ability to design the architecture and write the code.
A track record of defining evaluation frameworks for AI product quality, combining automated metrics with human review, and optimizing inference for latency, throughput, and cost.
Strong background in developer tools or IDE-like platforms, with a proven ability to set technical direction and raise quality across multiple teams as an individual contributor.

An innovative technical leader who wants to build the AI systems that power the creativity of millions.
Product-minded, with a real understanding of developer needs, creator workflows, and how AI systems land in the user experience.
Adaptable and curious, with good judgment about when to build, when to reuse, and when to push a need back to a model team.

Experience in mixed use environments - office, industrial, labs or manufacturing
